sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Pressing in vertex ; better, hard pressure with
hand. Pressing-together pain. Weight pressing on brain
with every step on ascending. Pain from nape over
whole brain ; better, .stooping, sitting ; worse, going up-
stairs. Cracking in jaw and twitching of facial muscles.

Abdomen
sections.text:
Distended and full ; increased by smok-
ing tobacco. Coldness of abdomen.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Icy coldness of hands and feet. Cramp-
like pain. As soon as patient lies down, legs jerk and
tivitch.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Coldness predominates ; felt most acutely in
abdomen and legs and tip of nose.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
IVorse, during rest, ascending. Better,
pressure on affected part, stooping, motion.

sections.text:
Compare: Caps.; Puls.; Calc.; Phos.
oc.; Sang.

Antidote: Caniph.

Dose, — Third to thirtieth potency.

15. Male Sexual Organs. — Increase of sexual desire, without excite-

17. Respiratory Organs. — When speaking hoarse and rough voice»

Stitch in anterior regions of larynx, impeding deglutition. — Dyspnoea. — Spas-

SO. Neck and Back. — Rigidity and heaviness in muscles of neck

22. Upper Limbs. — Paralytic tearing and spasmodic drawings in arms,

26. Sleep. — ^Agitated sleep, with vivid, unremembered dreams.
